title: Science and faith
tagline: Evolution, the Big Bang, Galileo and miracles: how the Church and the sciences fit together.
whyItMatters: Many young people believe they must choose between science and faith. The Church has taught for a long time that truth cannot contradict truth.

mindset.tip: Separate what science actually shows from the philosophy of "scientism" that is sometimes added to it.
Do not defend what the Church has never taught; Catholics are not required to hold a young earth (CCC 159, 283-284).
Admit real mistakes in history, such as the Galileo case, and put them in context.
Learn from Catholic scientists; their lives show the two can live together.
